# TradingView GEX by FlashAlpha

> TradingView GEX by FlashAlpha (GitHub: FlashAlpha-lab/tradingview-gex-flashalpha) draws options gamma exposure (GEX) on a TradingView-style candlestick chart built on TradingView Lightweight Charts: call wall, put wall, gamma flip, max pain, 0DTE magnet, gamma regime, net GEX, a strike heatmap, a GEX profile, delta / vanna / charm exposure and 0DTE metrics such as the pin score. Data comes from the FlashAlpha options analytics API and needs a FlashAlpha API key. It is not a TradingView Pine Script indicator: it is a chart you embed on your own website or app.

Embed in one line: `<div data-flashalpha-chart data-symbol="SPY" data-layers="levels,maxpain,netgex" style="height:520px"></div>` plus `<script async src="https://charts.flashalpha.com/embed.js" data-key="YOUR_FLASHALPHA_API_KEY"></script>`. Layer IDs: `levels` (call wall, put wall, gamma flip), `maxpain`, `magnet` (0DTE magnet), `netgex`, `heatmap`, `profile`. npm: `npm install tradingview-gex-flashalpha lightweight-charts@5.3.0`, then `import { mount } from 'tradingview-gex-flashalpha'` and `mount(el, { lightweightCharts, baseUrl: 'https://charts.flashalpha.com', apiKey, symbol: 'SPX', layers: ['levels', 'maxpain'] })`; the npm package draws the core layers `levels` and `maxpain`, the other layers come from the chart host (embed, or the script build plus https://charts.flashalpha.com/flashalpha-chart-layers.js). Symbols: US stocks, ETFs and indices such as SPX, SPY, QQQ, AAPL, MSFT, TSLA. Intervals: 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 1d, 1w.

Plans: Free = candles and volume. Basic = GEX Levels (call wall, put wall, gamma flip, max pain, 0DTE magnet), Net GEX pane, delta / vanna / charm exposure panes. Growth = Basic plus strike heatmap, GEX profile with GEX / DEX / VEX / CHEX lenses, 0DTE scope, 0DTE and volatility metrics. Alpha = Growth plus live open interest. Levels are model estimates from open interest, not financial advice.

## Indicators

- [Overview and FAQ](https://github.com/FlashAlpha-lab/tradingview-gex-flashalpha#readme): all indicators, benefits, plans, embed, FAQ
- [GEX Levels](https://github.com/FlashAlpha-lab/tradingview-gex-flashalpha/blob/main/docs/indicators/gex-levels.md): call wall, put wall, gamma flip, max pain, 0DTE magnet, regime tint, broken walls
- [Net GEX](https://github.com/FlashAlpha-lab/tradingview-gex-flashalpha/blob/main/docs/indicators/net-gex.md): net dealer gamma exposure in dollars under the price
- [Strike heatmap and GEX profile](https://github.com/FlashAlpha-lab/tradingview-gex-flashalpha/blob/main/docs/indicators/gex-by-strike.md): net GEX per strike behind the candles and at the right edge, GEX / DEX / VEX / CHEX lenses
- [Expiry heatmap](https://github.com/FlashAlpha-lab/tradingview-gex-flashalpha/blob/main/docs/indicators/expiry-heatmap.md): gamma by strike and by expiration in a panel beside the chart, totals per strike and per expiry
- [Expected move](https://github.com/FlashAlpha-lab/tradingview-gex-flashalpha/blob/main/docs/indicators/expected-move.md): the options-implied 1σ range of each session from its open
- [Level events](https://github.com/FlashAlpha-lab/tradingview-gex-flashalpha/blob/main/docs/indicators/level-events.md): rejections, breaks and flip crossings at the GEX levels, regime flips, OPEX and earnings days
- [0DTE hedging flow](https://github.com/FlashAlpha-lab/tradingview-gex-flashalpha/blob/main/docs/indicators/0dte-hedging-flow.md): the stock dealers had to buy or sell to hedge today's 0DTE trades, with divergences
- [Greeks and 0DTE metrics](https://github.com/FlashAlpha-lab/tradingview-gex-flashalpha/blob/main/docs/indicators/metrics-pane.md): delta, vanna, charm, 0DTE pin score, IV ratio, VIX, dealer hedge per 1 %
- [0DTE scope and live OI](https://github.com/FlashAlpha-lab/tradingview-gex-flashalpha/blob/main/docs/indicators/0dte-and-live-oi.md): same-day expiry levels and live open interest
